title: On the 175 th night of people presence on the streets of Tehran (August 22nd) in support of governmeny and condemning US-Israeli aggression against the country, crowds gathered in Tehran's Enqelab (Revolution) Square. Chanting the iconic slogans "Death to America" and "Death to Israel," the demonstrators symbolically hanged and executed effigies representing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and former US President Donald Trump.
